criteria.description: List available identities and identify the plugin-selected identity.
Select an identity per composition without changing the default, including wildcard domains, reply-to, Bcc, and signature behavior.
Create a bounded plain-text draft without invoking EmailSubmission/set.
Read, revise, and explicitly discard drafts with optimistic concurrency and auditable results.
Preview the exact identity, recipients, headers, body, and attachments before submission.
Submit only an existing reviewed draft through a distinct explicit outbound action.
Query submission state and report delivery status and errors truthfully.
Schedule or undo only when advertised and verified; otherwise return an explicit unsupported result.
Expose bounded SearchSnippet/get results without broadening untrusted content access.
Pass contract checks for Stalwart, Fastmail, Cyrus, Apache James, and the generic JMAP profile.
Publish operator guidance, compatibility limits, migration notes, and an outbound-boundary security review.
